title: 第22章 穷人家的孩子早当家
novel_title: 1960：九个妹妹把我宠上天(天下第九)
content_zh: “那你们谁去喊大伯他们过来帮忙？”辰楠看着妹妹们一脸笑容，还真是一群小可爱。“我去。”“我也去。”妹妹们相继举起，一下就有五六个人想要去通知大伯。看来大伯平时对他们也是挺不错的，否则也不会争着要去通知大伯。“那你们一起去都可以，不过要保密哦，不能让其他人知道，否则你们的肉就要分给别人吃了。”妹妹们欢快地答应下来，她们肯定会保密的。跟她们玩可以，分她们的肉不行！她们都不记得多久没吃过肉了，哪怕有肉吃的时候，也是九个人分一点点肉，只能闻闻或者舔舔味道，根本就不够吃。妹妹们手拉手朝门外小跑而去。一下少了一半人，院子里顿时就安静了许多。“哥哥，我去帮忙烧水。”招娣忙去了。其余小妹也围绕在招娣身边帮忙递柴火。辰楠看着懂事的妹妹们心绪复杂，这个年代的人真的很懂事。或许这就是穷人家的孩子早当家吧，几岁的妹妹就像是个小大人。野猪肉多，一餐肯定吃不完。吃不完的就需要腌起来，腌肉当然没新鲜肉好吃。辰楠想着大伙都太久没吃肉，那就使劲吃一顿。吃不完的再腌制起来，如今这天气太热，新鲜肉放不久。大伯帮了他们许多忙，不如叫大伯过来帮忙，顺便也能让他们带点肉回去。毕竟都是一家人，现在粮食这么紧张，多一口肉就能多撑几天。这叫知恩图报。“阿爷阿奶，”辰楠看着二老认真开口，“这野猪这么大，咱仨处理不过来，喊大伯他们过来帮忙应该没问题吧？”根据脑海中的记忆，爷爷有两个儿子一个女儿。大儿子在乡下当了大队长，二女儿嫁在附近公社，三儿子也就是在城里的辰东南。老三早年一个偶然的机会去城里当了工人，算是家里最有出息的，只是工作太忙，一年不一定能回来两趟。大伯有四个儿子，都在村里种地，娶了媳妇后开枝散叶俨然成了一个大家庭。爷爷不是老思想，当即做主分了家，自已带着老伴住这老院子，说是“分开住清净，少些家长里短的矛盾。奶奶正蹲在地上摸野猪，闻言笑着抬头：“好啊！”原本她还担心孙子不想叫其他人过来，毕竟多一个人就要少吃一口肉，大儿子家的人可不少。“肯定没问题！”爷爷听了这话，嘴角都快笑裂了。年纪大了就是喜欢家庭和睦，有吃的喊一下，有事也喊一下。这话辰楠先说出来，比他们说出来强百倍。“你大伯杀猪有经验，叫他来正好！”爷爷点点头：“咱这地方在村边皮，就算动静大点，也不怕被外人知道。”爷爷一脸慈祥地看着辰楠，怎么看怎么喜欢，咱孙子就不是个吃独食的人。另一边。二妹来娣带着几个妹妹来到一处泥砖瓦房前停下，只见木门虚掩着。她带着妹妹们推开门就往里走去。“大伯！大伯你在家吗？”很快里屋就传来了动静。只见一个膀大腰圆，三十多岁的农村汉子走了出来。这是堂二哥，他比爷爷要高大威猛，身板结实，一看就是干农活的好手。“来娣，吃了没？”“还没呢！”“那就留下来吃点再走。”“不了不了。”来娣赶紧摇头，“二哥，大伯在家吗？”“你大伯今天去公社开会还没回来，找大伯做什么？找二哥也是一样的。”辰建国作为老二，宁愿把自已的那一份给妹妹们吃，也不会缺妹妹们那一口。毕竟他们老爹只生了他们四兄弟，因此他们对招娣等堂妹倒是很不错。他刚在大队部吃了大锅饭回来不久，可是根本吃不饱，回家还会继续吃点。虽说开设公共食堂后每家每户不得存粮，一切粮食都要交给食堂做‘大锅饭’，但很多户人家多多少少都会偷偷存点粮食。如今生产队严重缺粮，哪怕是大锅饭也难以让人吃饱。大锅饭养懒人的弊端已现，听说上面已经在某些地方试点结束大锅饭，回归每家每户各吃各的。相信要不了多久，这种有着严重弊端的大锅饭时代将会彻底结束。“今天就不在二哥家吃饭啦。”来娣笑嘻嘻地拒绝，她知道大伯家也没什么好吃的，而且也不能总是来大伯家吃饭，她都11岁了，也该懂事。她朝门外看了看，见没人才把头凑过去。看这神秘的样子是有秘密？来娣这是想干啥？辰建国诧异地弯下了腰。来娣压低声音道，“二哥，我哥哥今天回来啦。”“你哥哥回来了啊！那等会我给他带点吃的过去。”辰建国露出一抹微笑，以前那爱跟在他屁股后面晃悠的堂弟，现在已经是城里人，而他也已经成家，见面的机会也少了许多。“我哥哥在山上捡了头刚死的野猪，哥哥让我来叫大伯过去帮忙，大伯不在家怎么办呀？”“你说啥？你哥不仅回来了，他还捡了只野猪？”“是呀二哥，我哥哥可厉害了。”几个妹妹七嘴八舌地说着野猪有多大，甚至还用双手比划了一番。来娣也很是认真的点点头。辰建国眼睛一下子瞪圆，那么多小妹都说看见野猪，那肯定就是真的。“辰楠那家伙的运气也太好了吧？”“哥哥说，让你们去帮忙。”来娣喜欢大伯一家，人多肯定热闹。辰建国听明白了，以前没白疼辰楠那小子。他搓搓手，一脸的激动，“我这就跟你走，不，来娣你带着妹妹们先回去。”“我顺便去叫你大哥三哥四哥！”辰建国是个急性子，立马转身进屋跟媳妇说了一声，然后就往田里走去。他们一家子都还未分家，只是爷奶不想跟他们一起居住而已。老三辰建军正在田里放水，听了消息也愣了半天，反应过来后赶紧放下锄头，就跟老三一起去爷爷家。老大辰建设，老四辰建民，一听有野猪，顿时兴奋到不行，听到消息后直接就往爷爷家里赶去。
content_en: "Then, which one of you will call the uncle and the others to come and help?" Chen Nan looked at the sisters with smiles on their faces. They are really a bunch of cuties."I'm going." "I'm going too." The sisters raised their hands one after another, and at once there were five or six people who wanted to inform the uncle.It seems that the uncle is usually very good to them, otherwise he would not rush to inform the uncle."Then you can go together, but you have to keep it a secret. Don't let others know, otherwise your meat will be shared with others." The sisters agreed happily, and they would definitely keep it a secret.You can play with them, but you can't share their flesh!They couldn't remember how long it had been since they had eaten meat. Even when there was meat, the nine of them shared a little bit of meat, and they could only smell or lick the taste, which was not enough to eat at all.The sisters trotted out the door hand in hand.Suddenly half the people were missing, and the courtyard suddenly became much quieter."Brother, I'm going to help boil the water." Zhao Di hurriedly went.The other little girls also gathered around Zhaodi to help pass out firewood.Chen Nan looked at the sensible sisters with complicated emotions. People in this era are really sensible.Maybe this is because children from poor families have already taken charge of their family, and their younger sister is like a little adult.There is so much wild boar meat that you will definitely not be able to finish it all in one meal.If you can't finish it, you need to marinate it. Of course, marinated meat is not as delicious as fresh meat.Chen Nan thought that everyone had not eaten meat for a long time, so she would eat hard.If you can't finish it, pickle it. The weather is too hot now, so the fresh meat won't last long.The uncle has helped them a lot, why not ask him to come over to help, and also let them bring some meat back.After all, we are all a family, and food is so tight now that an extra bite of meat can last a few more days.This is called gratitude."Grandpa and grandma," Chen Nan said seriously while looking at the two elders, "This wild boar is so big that the three of us can't handle it. It shouldn't be a problem if we call uncle and the others to come over and help, right?" According to the memory in his mind, grandpa has two sons and one daughter.The eldest son became a captain in the countryside, the second daughter married in a nearby commune, and the third son was Chen Dongnan in the city.The third child went to the city by chance to work as a worker in his early years. He was considered the most promising in the family, but he was too busy with work and might not be able to come back twice a year.The uncle has four sons, all of whom are farming in the village. After marrying his wife, the family has become a big family.Grandpa was not an old-fashioned thinker, so he immediately decided to separate the family, and he and his wife lived in this old courtyard. He said that "living separately is clean and there will be less conflicts between parents." Grandma was squatting on the ground touching the wild boar. Hearing this, she looked up with a smile and said, "Okay!""Originally, she was worried that her grandson wouldn't want to invite other people over. After all, one more person would mean one less bite of meat, and the eldest son's family has a lot of people. "It must be no problem!"When grandpa heard this, his mouth almost broke with laughter. As he gets older, he likes family harmony. He shouts when he has something to eat and shouts when something happens. Chen Nan said this first, which is a hundred times better than them saying it. "Your uncle has experience in killing pigs, so it's just right to call him!Grandpa nodded: "Our place is on the edge of the village. Even if there is a lot of noise, we are not afraid of being known by outsiders.""Grandpa looked at Chen Nan kindly. No matter how he looked at it, he liked it. Our grandson is not a solitary eater. On the other side, the second sister Laidi and several younger sisters came to a mud brick house and stopped. The wooden door was ajar. She and her sisters pushed the door open and walked in. "Uncle!Uncle, are you at home?"Soon there was movement in the back room. I saw a big, round-waisted rural man in his thirties walking out. This is the second cousin. He is taller and more powerful than grandpa, with a strong body. He looks like a good hand at farm work. "Laidi, have you eaten?"Not yet!""Then stay and have something to eat before leaving.""No, no, no."Laidi quickly shook her head, "Second brother, is uncle at home?""Your uncle went to the commune for a meeting today and hasn't come back yet. What should you do with your uncle?"The same goes for finding your second brother."As the second eldest child, Chen Jianguo would rather give his share to his sisters than lack a bite from them. After all, their father only gave birth to four brothers, so they treated Zhaodi and other cousins very well. He had just returned from a big pot of rice at the brigade headquarters, but he was not full at all, and would continue to eat more when he returned home. Although after the public canteen was opened, each household was not allowed to store food, and all food had to be handed over to the canteen for cooking"Pot rice", but many families secretly save some food.Nowadays, the production team is seriously short of food, and even a big pot meal can hardly feed people.The disadvantages of using big pot rice to feed lazy people have been revealed. I heard that the government has tried to end the big pot rice in some places and return each family to eat their own food.I believe that it will not be long before this era of big pot rice with serious disadvantages will be completely over."Laidi refused with a smile. She knew that there was nothing delicious at the uncle's house, and she couldn't always come to the uncle's house for dinner. She was already 11 years old, and she should be sensible. She looked outside the door, and only when she saw no one did she move her head towards it. Does this mysterious look mean there is a secret? What does Laidi want to do? Chen Jianguo bent down in surprise. Laidi lowered his voice and said, "Second brother, my brother is back today."Your brother is back!"I'll bring him some food later."Chen Jianguo showed a smile. The cousin who used to love to hang around behind him is now a city dweller, and he has also started a family, so there are fewer opportunities to meet him. "My brother picked up a freshly dead wild boar on the mountain. My brother asked me to call my uncle to help. What should I do if my uncle is not at home?"What did you say?"Not only is your brother back, he also picked up a wild boar?"Yes, second brother, my brother is amazing.""The girls kept talking about how big the wild boar was, and even gestured with their hands. Laidi also nodded seriously. Chen Jianguo's eyes suddenly widened. If so many girls said they saw wild boars, it must be true. "Isn't that guy Chen Nan very lucky?"Brother said, let you go and help.""Laidi likes her uncle's family. It's definitely lively when there are a lot of people. Chen Jianguo understood. He didn't hurt Chen Nan in vain before. He rubbed his hands with excitement on his face, "I'll go with you right now. No, Laidi, you take your sisters back first."I'll call you eldest brother, third brother, and fourth brother by the way!""Chen Jianguo was impatient. He immediately turned around and went into the house to talk to his wife, and then walked to the fields. Their family has not been separated yet, but his grandma did not want to live with them. The third child, Chen Jianjun, was draining water in the fields. Listen.I was stunned for a long time after hearing the news. After I realized it, I quickly put down the hoe and went to my grandfather's house with the third child.The eldest brother, Dachen Jianshe, and the fourth child, Jianmin, were so excited when they heard about the wild boars. After hearing the news, they rushed to their grandfather's house.
